meta.name: ppt-generator
meta.description: 基于七角色协作的智能 PPT 生成与优化工具。支持主题生成、模板推荐、内容填充、AI 智能配图、文本润色和 PPTX 文件生成。适用于学术汇报、商业演示、培训课件、产品发布等多种场景。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据主题自动生成专业演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作结构完整、视觉美观的PPT
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional presentations from a topic
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create well-structured, visually appealing slides

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按七个角色依次工作来生成或优化 PPT:先整理主题和结构,再推荐版式与风格,然后填充内容、配图并润色,最后把内容转成 .pptx 文件;也支持只做大纲、只做配图或只优化文字。
howto.when: 当你说要制作 PPT、优化现有 PPT 内容,或要求基于某个主题生成演示文稿时触发;也可能在你只想要大纲、布局或配图建议时启动对应分支。

say.text: 把这份大纲做成 10 页 PPT,受众是公司高管
say.note: 会补齐内容并生成 .pptx 文件

say.text: 只给我 PPT 大纲和每页版式推荐
say.note: 走快速模式,不生成文件

say.text: 润色这段文字,改成适合放 PPT 的要点

howto.what_en: Claude uses a seven-role workflow to build or improve PPTs: it analyzes the topic, suggests layouts, fills content, recommends images, polishes text, and outputs a .pptx. Partial modes (outline-only, image-only, text-only) are also supported.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request to create a PPT, improve existing slides, or generate a deck from a topic. Partial modes for outlines, layouts, images, or text polishing are also available.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into a 10-page PPT for senior managers.
say_en.note: Fills content and generates a .pptx file.

say_en.text: Give me just a PPT outline and per-slide layout suggestions.
say_en.note: Runs quick mode without generating a file.

say_en.text: Polish this text into bullet points suitable for a slide.
say_en.note: Only text optimization, no file output.
